description: Upload a file into the agent's knowledge base. Multipart uploads cannot travel over MCP, so pass the file EITHER as `url` (a publicly reachable https URL this service downloads) OR as `content_base64` (the file's bytes, base64-encoded) - exactly one of the two, always with `file_name`. This service performs the multipart upload to Meta for you and returns the created {id, file_name}. Known limitations: Meta caps a file at 100 MB and accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, PNG, JPG and JPEG (CSV and XLSX where enabled). Base64 content is additionally capped by this endpoint's request size limit, so prefer `url` for anything larger than a few megabytes. A `url` must be https and must resolve to a public address - private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. Use `url` instead for large files.

file_name.description: Name to store the file under, including its extension, e.g. 'returns-policy.pdf'.

url.description: Publicly reachable https URL to download the file from.

name: mba_upload_file
title: Upload a knowledge file
